before_times: What it's for: a birthday, a school or shop event, a fair or festival, or a lesson
The date and the start and end time (the painting time is the party's hours)
Where: a home, a park, a school, a hall or another venue, and the town only (for the travel fee)
How many guests, and roughly their ages (it sets how many painters and how long)
Indoors, outdoors, or both (an outdoor party has a weather rule)
Add-ons: a second painter, glitter tattoos, extra time
after_time: The host's name and mobile, and a day-of contact if the host won't be there
Where to set up: a table near a plug or the light, and a chair for each painter
Any theme the party wants (a superhero, a princess, animals); a photo, if there is one, on the secure page
The do-not-paint list for the guests: anyone who can't be painted, answered on the secure page
secure_page_only: Known allergies (to a paint, glitter or a fragrance) and skin conditions, each child's answer from a parent, on a link the booker forwards
A past reaction to face paint or glitter
The party's street address and any gate or door code
A child's name and age, and the child's own do-not-paint notes
May the business show photos of the painting? Each guest's own yes; a parent for anyone under 18
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult. A parent books a kids' party and stays. For a school or company event, someone the school or company names. The booker answers only for themselves; each child's notes come from a parent on the secure page.

stop.words: A reaction now: swelling of the face, lips or throat, hives all over, or trouble breathing
stop.booking: No booking, and the painter and the owner are told. No paint goes on a reacting face; that child is not painted again.

stop.words: Paint or glitter in the eye with pain or a change in sight
stop.says: Rinse the eye with clean running water for 15 minutes. If you can't see or it's badly hurt, call 911 now. Otherwise see a doctor today.
stop.booking: No booking for that child until a doctor says it's fine.

go_on.words: A rash, redness, itching or puffiness after the paint, with no danger signs
go_on.says: Wash the paint off gently with water and a mild soap. Don't add more. Your painter will call you.
go_on.booking: The painter calls within the hour (the owner if the painter is silent 15 minutes) and decides: a different paint, a patch test next time, or a doctor.

go_on.words: A cold sore, pink eye, a sty or open skin where the paint goes, on the day
go_on.says: No paint on that spot, so it can't spread or get worse.
go_on.booking: The painter works around it or leaves that spot bare. The rest of the party goes on as booked; no fee is kept for a child who can't be painted for a skin reason.

safety_and_stop_words.always: Always on: danger to life, fire, gas, or a medical emergency gets 'call 911' first. Rosie never judges a reaction: the painter or a doctor decides.

prep: The final party form and the do-not-paint list, 2 days before
The host's mobile, and where the painters park and come in
A table and an outlet near the front, if the venue doesn't set them
Kids: come with clean faces, no lotion, and tell the painter about any skin spots

staff.licenses_or_certificates: None needed for face painting in most places; the state form says. Glitter artists need no license of their own in most places.
staff.supervision: Students and new painters work only under a lead painter the owner names.
staff.who_oks: The owner OKs every quoted party, any stand-in lead and any extra painter added on the day.
staff.stand_in: At the studio: another studio painter with the skill, at the same time and price; with no reply 2 hours before, that stand-in comes, and the owner can turn this off. On location: a lead painter the owner trusts, offered by name; the agreement names the stand-in, so with no reply by 8pm the evening before, the stand-in comes and the owner calls. A full refund is always the other choice. The stand-in gets the party form and each child's secure notes.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult. A parent books a kids' party and stays. For a school or company event, someone the school or company names. The booker answers only for themselves; each child's notes come from a parent on the secure page.
children_and_age.minors_texts: A parent books a kids' party and stays. Rosie never texts a child first, and a child's name is never said in a text. A parent gives the yes for each child's face on the secure page.
children_and_age.minors_rules: A parent's yes for each child's face, and the parent stays. Nothing is painted on a child without that yes.

visit.done: The lead painter texts DONE when the last face is done and the table is packed up.
visit.changes_at_visit: An extra painter or extra time added on the day only if a painter is free, with the payer's written yes; paid at the visit or on the bill, as D91 says.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: None for face painting in most places. A local business license where the city or county asks for one, and a permit for a public or outdoor event where the state's form or the venue asks for one.
license.who: The business holds any business license or permit. Each painter needs no license of their own in most places; the state form says.
ask: The business's license or permit number, where the city or county asks for one
The liability insurance policy and its end date (schools, parks and venues often ask)
license.insurance: Liability insurance on file, with its end date, where a venue or the state's form asks. Many schools, parks and venues ask for a certificate naming them.
license.background: Only where the venue or the state's form asks, like a school or library event. The business's own word, never checked by Rosie.

never_in_a_text: Allergies, skin conditions, past reactions, patch-test results and medical notes, and any child's name, age or notes, stay on the secure page and the painter's job link, never in a text to the host, the owner or the staff. A text says only 'a note is on the page'.
